$Comment: The way into Hallow's Eve: go and find Old Jack in the Forgotten Temple. Nobody hands it over.
Flow.AutoAccept puts it in every player's quest log while the event runs, at their next login or
world change, and the base's Flow.AutoTrack pins it to their tracker. The _Hallows_Eve folder makes
The one step is a TURN_IN with a blank Target, handed in at the giver: nothing to bring, only the
walk. Old Jack's conversation hands it in from its first screen. Its pay is a Claim, like every
quest's: Hallows_Eve_Meet_Pay (a small welcome of sweets) waits in the quest to be collected. So
the hand-in parks the quest, and the conversation takes the player to it on Old Jack's own list,
Collect in front of them. Collecting it there plays his conversation again, and its beat with the
OnceId meet_patch_offer opens on Pumpkin Patch's offer. It names no TurnInAt, so the sweets can
also be collected from the quest log anywhere.
The Not group keeps it from anyone who already finished Pumpkin Patch, and with no Repeat it comes
once per player, ever. Pumpkin Patch does not wait on it: a player whose quest log was full when
this tried to arm still gets the questline from Old Jack.
Beside the table, MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row pays Acrobatics XP for the walk down, in Claim with the
rest. A server without that mod skips the row and shows nothing for it.
Name: Old_Jack_Meet
